verdict.rationale: Gmail's own docs clearly cover the undo-send half of the story: after sending, the user can click Undo within a configurable cancellation period of 5, 10, 20, or 30 seconds. The pack has no evidence of scheduling an email to send later; snooze, the offline Outbox and Gemini's meeting-time 'Schedule' are adjacent features and earn no credit. missing for 10: documented schedule-send-later capability, independent or hands-on corroboration of undo send.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can schedule an email to send later and undo a send within a grace window

citations.quote: Next to "Undo Send," select a Send cancellation period of 5, 10, 20, or 30 seconds.
Right after you send a message, you can retract it: ... Click Undo.
If you decide you don't want to send an email, you have a short time after to cancel it.
